name: JV_TRANSACTION_CHANGES
description: This table contains the history of changes made manually to joint venture transactions.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CHANGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture transaction change.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture transaction that this change is associated with.

columns.name: BEFORE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The before status code of the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The after status code of the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_OWNERSHIP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The before ownership definition short name to be used when splitting the transaction amount for distribution to the stakeholders.

columns.name: AFTER_OWNERSHIP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The after ownership definition short name to be used when splitting the transaction amount for distribution to the stakeholders.

columns.name: BEFORE_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The before direct billed stakeholder of the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The after direct billed stakeholder of the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Before date used to identify when the transaction occurred. This date is based upon the setup of the Joint Venture System Options.

columns.name: AFTER_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: After date used to identify when the transaction occurred. This date is based upon the setup of the Joint Venture System Options.

columns.name: BEFORE_ASSIGNMENT_RULE_ID
columns.description: The before assignment rule used to assign the ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder to the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_ASSIGNMENT_RULE_ID
columns.description: The after assignment rule used to assign the ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder to the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: The before distribution only flag used to identify whether the transaction will be used for distribution only and not invoiced.

columns.name: AFTER_DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: The after distribution only flag used to identify whether the transaction will be used for distribution only and not invoiced.

columns.name: BEFORE_PROJECT_ID
columns.description: The before unique identifier for the project that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_PROJECT_ID
columns.description: The after unique identifier for the project that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_TASK_ID
columns.description: The before unique identifier for the project task that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_TASK_ID
columns.description: The after unique identifier for the project task that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The before unique identifier for the expenditure type that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The after unique identifier for the expenditure type that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_EXPENDITURE_ORG_ID
columns.description: The before unique identifier for the organization that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_EXPENDITURE_ORG_ID
columns.description: The after unique identifier for the organization that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: BEFORE_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE
columns.description: The before date when the expenditure associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction was incurred.

columns.name: AFTER_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE
columns.description: The after date when the expenditure associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction was incurred.

columns.name: BEFORE_EXPENDITURE_BU_ID
columns.description: The before unique identifier for the expenditure business unit that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: AFTER_EXPENDITURE_BU_ID
columns.description: The after unique identifier for the expenditure business unit that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the reason for updating the transaction. It is based on ORA_JV_TRANS_CHG_REASON_CODE lookup codes.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_ADDITIONAL_TEXT
columns.description: Additional information describing the reason for updating the transaction.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
